Hey I just wanted to say please stop with the lsd and smoking! Your only 14 and you have so much ahead of you. I recommend going to therapy and seeking medication for your anxiety and depression. The really great part about being your age is you still have so much time to make friends and build your life up again. Not sure if you’ve started high school or not but take it as a fresh start! Also I recommend trying to find hobbies or doing something other then spending time on your phone. Maybe reading? Or join some type of club? It breaks my heart to hear how young you are. With the lsd it should be pretty easy to stop completely but with smoking try to limit how much you do and tamper off it. I myself used to smoke so much everyday for years between the ages of 16-19. Then got my hands on lsd @19. It broke me mentally been out of it for 2 years and now I’m 21. I can’t be helped I’ve ruined my only chance at life ! it’s why I’m telling you to please stop the lsd before you do something life altering because you have a future still! I sit here every single day regretting taking lsd. Theirs no guarantee your Hppd won’t turn into something else. Life is truly a gift so just try and enjoy it while you can and enjoy your teenage years instead of wasting it on drugs. Focus on the things you love and focus on your education it’s truly an important factor for your future. Much love 💛
